title: Kernel pair of a quotient by a monomorphic equivalence relation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U$ and $R$ be schemes over $S$, and let $j=(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be a monomorphism whose image on $T$-points is an equivalence relation on $U(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$. Let $U/R$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] of the presheaf quotient. Then the canonical map of fppf sheaves $h_R\to h_U\times_{U/R}h_U$ induced by $(s,t)$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Evaluate the presheaf coequalizer at T; evaluation preserves this coequalizer. Map it, by its universal property, into the quotient set of U(T) by the equivalence relation hrel T. Quotient.exact shows that equality of coequalizer classes implies one relation witness, rather than a chain. If two U-sections have equal images in F, local injectivity of η from the first step gives a covering equalizer sieve of their coequalizer classes. Naturality and this quotient calculation supply relation witnesses on every arrow in that covering sieve.

source.place: Tag 045Y, with the quotient-sheaf definition immediately preceding it; Mathlib coequalizer and setoid quotient APIs

proof.text: The two projections jointly determine a relation section because prod.lift s t is mono. Consequently local relation witnesses from the preceding step form a compatible family. Representables are sheaves for the fppf topology and its over topology, so the relation family glues. Separatedness of the representable U-sheaf verifies both projections of the glued section. Together with joint injectivity this proves the pullback square pointwise in Type; IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app yields the presheaf pullback.
